## Description

Allocates to minimize aggregate or portfolio-weighted correlation exposure, sometimes subject to return, weight and liquidity constraints.

## Where it may fit

Diversified portfolios seeking lower co-movement and lower risk concentration.

## Vehicles

Equity/ETF, multi-asset, factor and defensive allocation funds.

## Required data

Rolling correlation/covariance matrix, returns, bounds, sector constraints, liquidity and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Correlation is unstable and can rise in crises; optimization can be sensitive to noisy estimates and impose high turnover.
